lines.t: Kingdom… within…
Greater reality… breaking in…
I see the galaxies spin in Your eyes,
Greater reality over my lies,
My life hidden with You in the sky,
Old man falls, new man rise.
From death unto Life we go,
Cross on my back, let the pride die slow,
Yeah, I’m a battlefield, heart like Zion,
Cities of men, but the King keeps eyein’
Every wall, every idol I’m defyin’,
Old man crucified, no more lyin’.
He said, “Already passed from judgment, son,”
Perfected in My sight, what I started is done,
But I’m pressing like Paul, still learning to run,
In this lesser reality under the sun.Unbelief block rain, keep clouds in chains,
Self-doubt speak death, but His Word remains,
He said, “If I cleanse you, why you still ashamed?”
So I cast that voice in the pit, un-named.
Not trust in flesh, but the Lamb once slain,
Blood on the door, I’m out of that grave,
He tore the veil, opened up the Holiest Place,
Now the Captain of my faith keep calling me higher in grace.
Not that I’ve already attained,
But I press on through the pain,
From glory to Glory again,
’Til the new man flames.
I see the galaxies spin in Your eyes,
Greater reality over my lies,
My life hidden with You in the sky,
Old man falls, new man rise.
Drag that future man into now by faith,
Put on the new, let the old erase,
Perfected forever, still running this race,
Victory in YahuShua all over this place.
He said, “Do you really know Me?” – heart checked, laid bare,
All my pretense fade in His stare, I swear,
Poor in spirit, I confess my need,
Cities of pride crumble as I bleed.
He destroying every church that I built in my head,
Every doctrine of men that kept my spirit dead,
I’m an inner Babylon getting leveled instead,
Til His Kingdom come, inner Zion widespread.Faith is the evidence, things not seen,
Yet He wrote my name where the pages gleam,
Perfected forever while I’m still being cleaned,
Sanctified soldier in the in-between.
So I sync to His view, let His eyes define,
Who I am in Him, not this carnal mind,
Greater reality, yeah, that’s the design,
I pull it into now when my faith aligns.
I am dead, yet I live…
Crucified with Him, yet I live…
Not I, but Mashiach in me…
Kingdom… within…
I see the galaxies spin in Your eyes,
Greater reality over my lies,
My life hidden with You in the sky,
Old man falls, new man rise.
From death into Life we ascend tonight,
On hardcore kicks and celestial light,
We dance in the fire of the Lamb who died,
And rose, and reigns inside.
